senses.gloss: pr. n. m. Shechem, son of Hamor the Hivite.
pr. n. pl. Shechem in Mount Ephraim.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 97:6">Gen. R. s. 97</cite>, end (ref. to <cite ref="Genesis 48:22">Gen. XLVIII, 22</cite>, v. <cite ref="U01170">preced.</cite>) <he>זו ש׳ ודאי</he> it means Shechem in reality.

<cite ref="Genesis 48:22">Ib.</cite> (in a corrupt passage) <he>לפיכך תהא הש׳ בחלקך</he> therefore shall the district of Sh. (or the mountain range, v. <cite ref="U01170">preced.</cite>) be in thy share.
<cite ref="Genesis 48:22">Ib.</cite> <he>בש׳ נפרצה וכ׳</he> in Sh. did unchastity break out, and thou didst fence it in (setting the example of chastity), therefore &c.
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 23">Num. R. s. 23</cite>, v. <cite ref="N00733"><he>נִיפּוֹלִין</he></cite>; a. fr.
